name: status-morph
title: Status Morph
description: An iPhone-style status bar (signal, Wi-Fi, battery) that takes itself apart to connect. Tap it and the battery drains, amber then red, before its outline rounds itself into a ring around the Wi-Fi. The signal bars sink into dots, swing under the ring and slide into its gap, and the ring spins while the Wi-Fi arcs ripple outward. When it connects, the spin coasts to rest, the ring closes over the dots with a soft pulse and the arcs fill in one by one. Tap again and it all folds back into the bar, this time charging, with a bolt.
